method: Full tar streams compressed with zstd -T2 -3, stdout byte count; pipefail enabled and all three pipelines exited 0. Archives were not stored. COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 and tar --no-xattrs omit macOS extended attributes; file contents and tar-supported hard links are retained.
scope_limits: Build products excluded. Code and documentation remain in the checkout.
External historical LK runs are measured separately; original LK source/output and unrelated temporary archives are not part of these streams.
Byte counts describe these current streams; archive manifests or subsequent evidence changes may slightly change final sizes.
